title: GitHub Stacks in Jujutsu
excerpt: Using GitHub's new stacked PRs with jj
content_html:
GitHub released it’s stacked pull request (PR) feature into public preview on 2026-07-30. It mainly targets git users but has documented support for other, git-compatible version control systems like Jujutsu (jj).

This is a primer for using GitHub stacks with jj.

Prerequisites

Install CLIs

  • You need the git (instructions) and jj (instructions) CLIs installed.
  • You need the gh GitHub CLI installed (instructions).
  • Install the stacking extension with gh extension install github/gh-stack

This article was written/tested against:

  • jj v0.43.0
  • git v2.52.0
  • gh v2.96.0
  • github/gh-stack v0.1.0

Configure jj

I will be re-using some jj aliases and revset aliases we defined in the previous article, Stacks in Jujutsu.

Bonus: Learn jj’s bookmark aliases

GitHub’s Stacked PRs require every PR to have a jj bookmark (git branch), so you’ll be creating a lot of these. UI tools in the future will surely automate creating branch names under the covers, but for now, learn the jj aliases for easily managing bookmarks:

Command Description
jj b l list bookmarks
jj b s <name> -r <commit> Create (or move) a bookmark to the given commit
jj b a Advance the nearest bookmark to the current commit (like jj tug)
jj b --help Docs with the aliases for all the commands

💡 Aside: Did you know that you can improve the default jj bookmark advance (jj b a) behavior by customizing the revset it uses? If you’re on a new, empty commit ABOVE a commit with code, you probably want to advance the bookmark to the code commit below you. You can accomplish this with:

jj makes it super easy to customize behavior by overriding the built-in bookmark-advance-to revset to whatever you want.

Manual Workflows

The gh stack CLI has a bunch of subcommands, most of which manage or consume local tracking of the stack (e.g. init, view). In a jj repo you will only use the few subcommands that manage the remote stack on GitHub (e.g. link, push), as follows:

Create a stack

  1. Create a bookmark for each commit in your stack:

  2. Upload your bookmarks to GitHub, create draft PRs for each, and link them all into a stack:

    Using our stack alias:

    Or, using a jj revision range:

    Or, since jj sb defaults to your substack, you can go to the top (where your stack and substack are the same thing) and then link the entire stack:

    This last one is probably the easiest to remember.

Add a new commit to the TOP of the stack

Assuming the new commit is change id abc:

  1. Make sure you’re editing your new commit:
  2. Create a bookmark for the new, current commit:
  3. If you’ve modified any of the downstack commits, you need to push the updates (since jj git push will do a --force-with-lease push, but gh stack link won’t):
  4. Re-run link with all stack bookmarks:
    The existing PRs (for everything downstack) will be skipped and the new branch will get a new draft PR and will be linked into the stack.

Add a new commit to the BOTTOM or MIDDLE of the stack

You can’t add to the middle of a stack (you’ll get an error: “Cannot update stack: new PRs must be added to the top of the existing stack”), so you have to delete your stack and recreate it. Assuming the new commit is change id abc:

  1. Go to the GitHub web UI and remove the stack:
  2. Create a bookmark for the new commit:
  3. Since you’ve modified the rebased, upstack commits, re-push everything:
  4. Re-run link with all stack bookmarks, including the new one:
    the existing PRs will be skipped, and the new branch will get a new draft PR and will be linked into the stack

Remove a commit from the stack

You have to delete your stack and recreate it. Assuming the commit to remove is change id abc:

  1. Go to the GitHub web UI and remove the stack:
  2. Make sure you’re at the top of the stack:
  3. Abandon the commit if you haven’t already:
  4. Push your updates:
  5. Re-run link with all stack bookmarks:
    the existing PRs will be skipped and the stack will be recreated
  6. Your removed commit will have an orphaned PR on GitHub. Manually close it and/or delete the remote branch if you want. Or, push all deleted bookmarks with jj git push --deleted.

NOTE: Deleting the remote branch closes its PR, so if you run the jj git push --deleted before re-running gh stack link ..., you will end up closing the PR ABOVE the removed branch as well. Delete after linking to avoid this.

  1. Re-push your stack:

Merge your stack

Like unstacking, it is theoretically possible to do it from the CLI, but too complicated:

So, just do this from the web UI. You’ll probably be there anyway, checking on that CI signal. 🤷🏽‍♀️

Updates

There are almost certainly ways to improve the above workflows that I’m totally missing. If you have one hit me up and I’ll update this article.

Impressions and closing

The future improvements I’m hoping for:

  1. GUI tools that build upon the manual steps above, automating away the tedium. I personally use the amazing VisualJJ vscode extension to do 80% of my jj commands and I assume the devs are working on adding GitHub stack support.
  2. gh stack extension getting a single gh stack submit subcommand that just figures stuff out, rendering everything above obsolete.
  3. Improvements to the workflows that require deleting the stack and recreating it, e.g. adding a commit to the middle of the stack.

As it is today, this stuff generally works and I’m very excited to get stacking functionality in GitHub. My initial impression is that one can immediately put this feature to good use, and I’m grateful to the developers that worked on this feature.

That said, let’s acknowledge the elephant in the room: this is an unambitious implementation of stacked PRs. GitHub’s stacked PRs build entirely on the existing, flawed model of GitHub PRs without changing any of the foundations:

I apologize for being somewhat direct but what prior art did you engage with? Why are you making people create a branch for each change in a stack? Why do developers have to create new commits when iterating on the PR? Where is the proper support for interdiffs? What about change IDs? -sunshowers on Hacker News

Instead of automatic change ids we get manual branches. Instead of an automatic gh stack submit (like graphite’s or git-branchless’ submit commands), you’re left feeding gh stack the list of branches by hand. Etc.

In short, go in with low expectations of the developer experience and you’ll be happy with the end result: a working PR stack in GitHub.

Prerequisites Install CLIs You need the git (instructions) and jj (instructions) CLIs installed. You need the gh GitHub CLI installed (instructions). Install the stacking extension with gh extension install github/gh-stack This article was written/tested against: jj v0.43.0 git v2.52.0 gh v2.96.0 github/gh-stack v0.1.0 Configure jj I will be re-using some jj aliases and revset aliases we defined in the previous article, Stacks in Jujutsu. Bonus: Learn jj’s bookmark aliases GitHub’s Stacked PRs require every PR to have a jj bookmark (git branch), so you’ll be creating a lot of these. If you’re on a new, empty commit ABOVE a commit with code, you probably want to advance the bookmark to the code commit below you. You can accomplish this with: [revset-aliases."closest_pushable(to)"]definition = 'heads(::to & mutable() & ~empty() & description(regex:".+"))'doc = "Closest mutable, non-empty, described commits at or behind to"[revsets]bookmark-advance-to = "closest_pushable(@)" jj makes it super easy to customize behavior by overriding the built-in bookmark-advance-to revset to whatever you want. content_html_zh:
GitHub 于 2026 年 7 月 30 日将其堆叠拉取请求 (PR) 功能发布到公共预览版。 它主要针对 git 用户，但也记录了对其他与 git 兼容的版本控制系统（如 Jujutsu (jj)）的支持。

这是将 GitHub 堆栈与 jj 一起使用的入门读物。

先决条件

安装 CLI

  • 您需要安装 git（指令）和 jj（指令）CLI。
  • 您需要安装 gh GitHub CLI（说明）。
  • 使用 gh extension install github/gh-stack 安装堆叠扩展

本文是根据以下内容编写/测试的：

  • jj v0.43.0
  • git v2.52.0
  • gh v2.96.0
  • github/gh-stack v0.1.0

配置jj

我将重新使用我们在上一篇文章《Jujutsu 中的堆栈》中定义的一些 jj 别名和 revset 别名。

奖励：了解 jj 的书签别名

GitHub 的 Stacked PR 要求每个 PR 都有一个 jj 书签（git 分支），因此您将创建很多这样的书签。 未来的 UI 工具肯定会在幕后自动创建分支名称，但现在，学习 jj 别名以轻松管理书签：

命令 描述
jj b l 列出书签
jj b s <名称> -r <提交> 创建（或移动）书签到给定的提交
jj b a 将最近的书签前进到当前提交（如 jj tug）
jj b --帮助 包含所有命令别名的文档

💡 旁白：您是否知道可以通过自定义其使用的转速集来改进默认的 jj 书签提前 (jj b a) 行为？ 如果您在包含代码的提交之上进行新的空提交，您可能希望将书签前进到您下面的代码提交。 您可以通过以下方式完成此操作：

jj 通过将内置书签-advance-revset 覆盖为您想要的任何内容，使自定义行为变得非常容易。

手动工作流程

gh stack CLI 有一堆子命令，其中大多数管理或使用堆栈的本地跟踪（例如 init、view）。 在 jj 存储库中，您将仅使用管理 GitHub 上的远程堆栈的几个子命令（例如 link、push），如下所示：

创建堆栈

  1. 为堆栈中的每个提交创建一个书签： # 使用我们的修订集别名转到堆栈底部jj edit -r "stack_bottom()"# 给提交一个名称jj b c <名称># 转到下一个提交jj next --edit# 给提交一个名称jj b c <名称># ... 对堆栈中的每个提交重复
  2. 将您的书签上传到 GitHub，为每个书签创建草案 PR，并将它们全部链接到一个堆栈中：使用我们的堆栈别名：gh stack link $(jj sb -r "stack()") 或者使用 jj 修订范围：gh stack link $(jj sb -r commit1::commitN) 或者，由于 jj sb 默认为您的子堆栈，您可以转到顶部（您的堆栈和子堆栈是同一件事），然后链接整个stack: jj top --editgh stack link $(jj sb) 最后一个可能是最容易记住的。

将新提交添加到堆栈顶部

假设新的提交是change id abc：

  1. 确保您正在编辑新提交： jj edit -r abc
  2. 为新的当前提交创建书签：jj b c <name>
  3. 如果您修改了任何 downstack 提交，则需要推送更新（因为 jj git push 将执行 --force-with-lease 推送，但 gh stack link 不会）： jj git push -r "stack()"
  4. 重新运行所有堆栈书签的链接： gh stack link $(jj sb) 现有的 PR（对于所有 downstack 的内容）将被跳过，新分支将获得新的草稿 PR 并将链接到堆栈中。

将新提交添加到堆栈的底部或中间

您无法添加到堆栈的中间（您将收到错误：“无法更新堆栈：新的 PR 必须添加到现有堆栈的顶部”），因此您必须删除堆栈并重新创建它。 假设新的提交是change id abc：

  1. 转到 GitHub Web UI 并删除堆栈：
  2. 为新提交创建书签： jj b c -r abc <name>
  3. 由于您已经修改了 rebased、upstack 提交，因此重新推送所有内容： jj git push -r "stack()"
  4. 重新运行包含所有堆栈书签（包括新书签）的链接： jj top --editgh stack link $(jj sb) 现有 PR 将被跳过，新分支将获得新的草稿 PR 并将链接到堆栈中

从堆栈中删除提交

您必须删除堆栈并重新创建它。 假设要删除的提交是更改 id abc：

  1. 转到 GitHub Web UI 并删除堆栈：
  2. 确保您位于堆栈的顶部：jj top --edit
  3. 如果您还没有放弃，请放弃提交： jj放弃-r abc
  4. 推送更新： jj git push -r "stack()"
  5. 重新运行包含所有堆栈书签的链接： jj top --editgh stack link $(jj sb) 将跳过现有 PR 并重新创建堆栈
  6. 您删除的提交将在 GitHub 上有一个孤立的 PR。 如果需要，可以手动关闭它和/或删除远程分支。 或者，使用 jj git push --deleted 推送所有已删除的书签。

注意：删除远程分支会关闭其 PR，因此如果您在重新运行 gh stack link 之前运行 jj git push --deleted ...，您最终也会关闭已删除分支之上的 PR。 链接后删除以避免这种情况。

更新现有堆栈的现有提交

  1. 重新推送你的堆栈： jj git push -r "stack()"

合并你的堆栈

与拆栈一样，理论上可以通过 CLI 来完成，但太复杂了：

因此，只需从 Web UI 执行此操作即可。 无论如何，你可能都会在那里检查 CI 信号。 🤷🏽‍♀️

更新内容

几乎可以肯定，有一些方法可以改进上述工作流程，但我完全不知道。 如果你有的话请联系我，我会更新这篇文章。

印象和结束语

我希望未来的改进：

  1. GUI 工具建立在上述手动步骤的基础上，自动化地消除了繁琐的工作。 我个人使用令人惊叹的 VisualJJ vscode 扩展来执行 80% 的 jj 命令，并且我认为开发人员正在努力添加 GitHub 堆栈支持。
  2. gh stack 扩展获取单个 gh stack Submit 子命令，该子命令只是计算出内容，使上面的所有内容都过时。
  3. 改进了需要删除堆栈并重新创建它的工作流程，例如将提交添加到堆栈中间。

就像今天一样，这些东西通常都能工作，我很高兴能够在 GitHub 中获得堆栈功能。 我的第一印象是，人们可以立即充分利用此功能，并且我很感谢开发此功能的开发人员。

也就是说，让我们承认房间里的大象：这是堆叠 PR 的一个没有雄心的实现。 GitHub 的堆叠 PR 完全建立在现有的、有缺陷的 GitHub PR 模型之上，而不改变任何基础：

我很抱歉有点直接，但你接触过哪些现有技术？ 为什么要让人们为堆栈中的每个更改创建一个分支？ 为什么开发人员在迭代 PR 时必须创建新的提交？ 对 interdiff 的适当支持在哪里？ 更改ID怎么办？ -《黑客新闻》上的太阳阵雨

我们没有自动更改 id，而是手动分支。 您需要手动向 gh stack 提供分支列表，而不是自动 gh stack 提交（如石墨或 git-branchless 的提交命令）。 ETC。

简而言之，对开发人员体验抱有较低的期望，您会对最终结果感到满意：GitHub 中的有效 PR 堆栈。
